modules.name: Shoal
modules.description: 8-track generative melody sequencer. Melodies grown from seeds, never stored.

modules.name: Shoal Outs
modules.description: 16 CV outputs for Shoal: per-track Currents (seeded drift CV) and end-of-sequence pulses. Sits to Shoal's left.

modules.name: Shoal Expander
modules.description: 12 CV inputs for Shoal parameters otherwise only reachable from its menu, addressed to the track chosen on its own knob. Chain several to modulate several tracks.
